say:3:1423377001:1.text: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.
say:3:1423377001:1.source_cn: 期盼已久了，我的大魔法师。
say:3:1423377001:1.male: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.
say:3:1423377001:1.female: I've been waiting to see you, great Magister.

say:4:1423377002:1.text: Alright, Ravion, what kind of job are you roping us into this time?
say:4:1423377002:1.source_cn: 沙利叶，你找我们来，不会是又有什么活要让我们干吧？

say:5:1423377003:1.text: The royal city's finally getting back on its feet. Order's been restored, construction's on track. From here on out, Essail need to figure things out on their own, without relying on <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:5:1423377003:1.source_cn: 如今王城的秩序已经恢复，各项建设也已经步入正轨。接下来...

say:6:1423377004:1.text: But today, I didn't call you here for work. I wanted to thank you, for everything you've done. And also... pass something along. From me, personally.
say:6:1423377004:1.source_cn: 这次请你们前来，是为专程表达对你们这段时间付出的感谢，...

say:8:1423377006:1.text: It's for Orlana. And I'd like you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, to be the one to give it to her. I think it'll mean more coming from you.
